tldr_pick: Zillow Premier Agent is still the highest-intent buyer traffic source in US real estate in 2026. Pair it with Follow Up Boss ($49/mo Starter) for CRM and lead routing, or Lofty ($399/mo Starter) for an all-in-one CRM + dialer + IDX site with AI assistant. Solo agents: Follow Up Boss Starter + Canva for marketing is the lean stack.
key_takeaways: Zillow is still the traffic source. Pair Zillow Premier Agent with a CRM (Follow Up Boss or Lofty) -- not as a replacement.
CRM is the foundation. Without lead routing and action plans, Zillow/Google/Facebook leads go cold in hours.
Lofty for all-in-one if your team budget covers $400+/mo; Follow Up Boss + Canva for lean stacks.
AI listings work but always edit for property-specific tone -- generic AI copy reads as such.
who_for: Solo real estate agents, small teams, and brokerages in the US (or any market where Zillow/Realtor.com are primary traffic sources) who want to systematize lead management, marketing, and follow-up without a dedicated marketing hire.
methodology: We aggregated 2026 reviews from G2, Capterra, Wirecutter, Zapier, and product-specific comparisons, then cross-referenced each tool's pricing, feature limits, workflow fit, and benchmark scores against the vendor's own pricing page in September 2026. Where reviewers disagreed, we noted the consensus and the outlier. This is an editorial roundup, not a hands-on benchmark -- every tool listed has a free tier or trial so you can verify fit before committing. Pricing verified September 2026.

faq.q: What is the best AI tool for real estate agents in 2026?
faq.a: It depends on the job: Follow Up Boss for CRM and lead routing, Lofty for AI-assisted nurture and a built-in dialer, and Zillow Premier Agent for top-of-portal visibility. Solo agents can run Lofty or Follow Up Boss + Canva for marketing.

faq.q: How much do AI real estate tools cost per month?
faq.a: Solo agents typically pay $50-200/mo for CRM (Follow Up Boss Starter at $49, Lofty at $399 for teams). Premier Agent-style ad placements are $20-50/wk per ZIP. High-volume tools (Ylopo Apex, Lofty Enterprise) start at $300-500/mo. Total monthly SaaS for an active solo agent lands at $200-500.

faq.q: Is Zillow Premier Agent still worth it in 2026?
faq.a: Yes, for most US buyer-side agents -- Zillow still sends the highest-intent buyer traffic. The ROI calculation has tightened (impressions-to-lead conversion dropped ~25% since 2023) so budget $20-40/wk per ZIP instead of the $50+/wk some teams paid in 2021-2022.

faq.q: Can I use AI to write listing descriptions?
faq.a: Yes. Lofty AI Assistant, Canva Magic Write, ChatGPT, and Claude all write serviceable listing descriptions. Always edit for the specific property's tone -- AI descriptions default to generic adjectives ("stunning," "spacious") that buyers skim past. Pair the AI draft with 2-3 property-specific details for the best result.

faq.q: What is the best CRM for solo real estate agents?
faq.a: Follow Up Boss Starter at $49/mo is the best value for solo agents -- lead routing, AI action plans, mobile dialer, and 200+ source integrations. Lofty Starter ($399/mo) is better if you also want a built-in IDX website and AI assistant, but the price jump is significant.

faq.q: Are AI real estate tools safe to use for client communication?
faq.a: For initial lead nurture and routine follow-up, yes. For contract-stage communication, price negotiation, or anything involving legal disclosures, AI-generated drafts need human review. Most CRMs (Follow Up Boss, Lofty) make this explicit in their terms of service.
